verdicts.reason: A keeps the original three-column layout, but the CTA is now tiny and visually weaker than the enlarged LIMITED badge, so the call to action is buried. The headline also breaks awkwardly as 'The Volt / Runner', the subtitle leaves 'Thursday.' orphaned, and the CTA floats with no shared baseline. B restructures sensibly with a full-width headline and a large, prominent CTA, but the headline sits cramped against the top edge and the shoe. The headline's left edge doesn't line up with the shoe's, 'Thursday.' is still orphaned, and the LIMITED badge floats loosely off the CTA instead of sitting with the product.
